anatomy: T-Rex: two hind legs, two front arms SHORTER than his head; pterodactyl two legs two wings
motion_rule: the T-Rex drives his whole bulk across frame in EVERY window, speech included; never from behind the counter, never from a stand; the granny pterodactyl in a headscarf stays in frame from 1.65 on; the meat moves in every window
camera_moves: low angle, ONE take, no cuts, camera always moving, shot size changing every window: race the planks, arc his snout, push the sign, travel the row
character: grumpy old T-Rex butcher, enormous head, tiny arms, stained apron, sleeves rolled up, one white daisy behind his ear
props: a long wooden counter; a mound of meat shoved along it; one wooden sign, drawings only: two radishes crossed out, a chicken beside them, no letters no digits; one cleaver
environment: clear noon, market row, wooden stalls, grass
lighting: blazing noon sun, bright throughout, hard shadows, sun burning through the slab she lifts

audio.delivery: gravelly old male voice, market barker, steady 4.5 syllables per second, never hurried
audio.pronunciation: natural native Russian stress, no accent
audio.pacing: one unbroken phrase per window, no pause inside a phrase spanning two windows, silence in wordless beats
audio.lip_sync: jaw works each syllable, mouth free of props, voice always from the T-Rex
audio.sfx: boards rumbling 0.0;counter bang 1.65;sign thump 2.5;cleaver through boards 5.05;slab scraping 5.7;wing beats 6.5;snatch 9.05

timeline.a: he charges the counter behind the mound, shouldering it along the boards, camera racing him low
he hurls the mound round to the lens, bulk turning after it, apron flying, camera arcing his snout
he rams the counter with his hip, boards jumping, the granny swinging into frame at his elbow
he stamps the sign into the mound, hauling his weight over it, camera pushing onto the drawings
he swings his bulk back down the row, snout leading, camera travelling with him
he rams the crossed-out radishes with his snout, driving the sign along the boards, the granny scuttling under him
he wheels his bulk round to the lens, tail sweeping the stalls, the mound sliding after him
he slams the cleaver through the boards by the drawn chicken, the granny huge at the lens
he throws his bulk down the row after the slab as she rips it off the counter and drags it away
he barges up the row under the slab she heaves against the sun, arms falling short
he shoulders the mound down the counter after her, boards shaking
he drives his bulk into the lens, snout filling the frame over her headscarf
he swings away down the row, tail lashing the mound along the boards ahead of him
he lunges after her as the daisy drops onto the slab and she snatches slab and flower, huge at the lens

must_appear: arms shorter than his head; stained apron, rolled sleeves, daisy behind his ear; a mound of meat moving along the counter; sign: two crossed-out radishes, a chicken
negative_prompt: cyrillic, letters, digits, subtitles, watermark, night, dark scene, hard cut, jump cut, human hands, second dinosaur, slow motion, slow speech, static camera, T-Rex standing still, reaching without moving his feet, T-Rex working from behind the counter, T-Rex absent from frame, floating props, pterodactyl small in the background, accented Russian
